vertical habitat use; flight height in vs out of WEA

```{r}
## Wilcoxon's tests and paired plots


### flight heights

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)

birds_sorted <- d5 %>%
  arrange(device_id, z_fit1)



birds_summary <- birds_sorted %>%
  group_by(device_id, position) %>%
  summarise(
    z_mean   = mean(z_fit1, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_median = median(z_fit1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = position,
    values_from = c(z_mean, z_median)
  ) %>%
  clean_names()

birds_long_median <- birds_summary %>%
  select(device_id, starts_with("z_median_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("z_median_"),
    names_to = "position",
    names_prefix = "z_median_",
    values_to = "z_median"
  )

library(ggplot2)

k=ggplot(birds_long_median, aes(x = position, y = z_median, group = device_id)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray70", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    # title = "Paired plot of median flight height by position",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Median flight height (meters)",
    # title="A."
  )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "in_wind_energy_area" = "In Wind Energy Area",
    "not_in_wind_energy_area" = "Not in Wind Energy Area"
  ))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +  # increases all base text sizes
  theme(
    # axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "serif")
  )

k

```


vertical habitat use; time in RHR in vs out of WEA

```{r}
birds_sorted <- birds_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    in_rhr = z_fit1 >= 27 & z_fit1 <= 255
  )


library(dplyr)

birds_rhr <- birds_sorted %>%
  arrange(device_id, UTC_datetime) %>%
  group_by(device_id, position) %>%
  summarise(
    total_time = sum(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    rhr_time   = sum(time_diff[in_rhr], na.rm = TRUE),
    rhr_prop   = rhr_time / total_time,
    rhr_percent = rhr_prop * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )



## put them in a suitable format



status_wide2 <- birds_rhr %>%
  select(device_id, position, rhr_prop) %>%   # keep only relevant columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = position,
    values_from = rhr_prop
  ) %>%
  clean_names()



## compare 
wilcox.test(status_wide2$in_wind_energy_area, status_wide2$not_in_wind_energy_area, paired = TRUE)

## paired plot

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

status_long <- status_wide2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -device_id,
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "rhr_prop"
  )



l=ggplot(status_long, aes(x = position, y = rhr_prop, group = device_id)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray70", alpha = 0.6) +   # line connecting paired points
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "steelblue") + # dot for each device
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    # title = "Paired plot of RHR proportion by position",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of time in rotor height range",
    # title="B."
  )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "in_wind_energy_area" = "In Wind Energy Area",
    "not_in_wind_energy_area" = "Not in Wind Energy Area"
  ))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +  # increases all base text sizes
  theme(
    # axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "serif")
  )
```

Chi-square test and plots

```{r}
### observed versus expected time in RSA

### Time in WEA vs RSA



# Remove last NA time_diff per device
birds_sorted <- birds_sorted %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_diff))



# Focus only on in_WEA positions
in_WEA_summary <- birds_sorted %>%
  filter(position == "in Wind Energy Area") %>%
  group_by(device_id, buffer_type) %>%
  summarise(total_minutes = sum(time_diff), .groups = "drop")



library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Pivot wider so each id has columns for each buffer_type
library(sf)

### Time in WEA vs time in RSA table

in_WEA_wide <- in_WEA_summary %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%              # drop sf class, keep just a plain dataframe
  mutate(buffer_type = str_trim(buffer_type)) %>%
  select(device_id, buffer_type, total_minutes) %>%
  group_by(device_id, buffer_type) %>%
  summarise(total_minutes = sum(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = device_id,
    names_from = buffer_type,
    values_from = total_minutes,
    values_fill = 0
  )


### p calculation # area(A)/area(B_total);
library(here)
library(sf)


turbines <- st_read(here("data", "shapefiles", 
             "uswtdb_V8_2_20251210.shp"))


# Subset turbines for one project
vineyard <- turbines %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_name == "Vineyard Wind")

plot(st_geometry(vineyard))


### vineyard turbine shapefile


# Reproject to UTM Zone 18N (in meters because we will calculate distances)
turbines_proj <- st_transform(vineyard, crs = 26918)


## installed turbine buffers

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Merge turbines by farm and year
turbine_union <- turbines_proj %>%
  dplyr::group_by(p_name, t_state) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))

### t_state has no data but apparently, this function needs two columns to group properly



# Rename the original geometry column to avoid name conflict
turbine_buffer_clean <- turbine_union
st_geometry(turbine_buffer_clean) <- "geom_orig"

# Create the two buffer columns, dist is radius
turbine_buffer_clean <- turbine_buffer_clean %>%
  mutate(
    buffer_2200m = st_buffer(geom_orig, dist = 2200),# expected spacing within windfarm, between the turbines
    buffer_116m = st_buffer(geom_orig, dist = 116)# based on blade length (radius) of 111m + 5m buffer; ie. diameter # of 222 + 10m buffer (Tjornlov 2021)
  )

# Pivot longer without geometry name conflict
turbine_buffer_long <- turbine_buffer_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(p_name, buffer_2200m, buffer_116m) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("buffer"),
               names_to = "buffer_type",
               values_to = "geom") %>%
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geom")  # explicitly set geometry column


# plot(st_geometry(turbine_buffer_long))






### recalculate buffer area and expected props



# Separate buffers for the subset

###Cumulative area of turbine swept area --RSA (116m buffer)
buffer_116m <- turbine_buffer_long %>%
  filter(buffer_type == "buffer_116m") %>%
  st_union()



###Cumulative area of wind energy area --WEA (~2200m buffer)
buffer_2200m <- turbine_buffer_long %>%
  filter(buffer_type == "buffer_2200m") %>%
  st_union()


### what % area of WEA is occupied by RSA?

# Calculate areas
area_116m <- st_area(buffer_116m) %>% as.numeric() ##2028190 m2
area_2200m <- st_area(buffer_2200m) %>% as.numeric() ##352818447 m2


# Percentage
percent_area <- (area_116m / area_2200m) * 100

cat("Percent area of buffer_116m relative to buffer_2200m:", 
    round(percent_area, 2), "%\n")



# Percent area of buffer_116m relative to buffer_2200m: 0.7 %

#########################################################################################################################


p <- 0.007  # proportion of WEA buffer area (B) that RSA buffer (A) occupies

##########################################

df <- in_WEA_wide %>%
  rename(obs_A = `buffer_116m`, obs_B = `buffer_2200m`) %>%
  mutate(
    obs_notA = obs_B,
    exp_A    = obs_B * p,
    exp_notA = obs_B * (1 - p)
  )

totals <- df %>%
  summarise(
    obs_A    = sum(obs_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_notA = sum(obs_notA, na.rm = TRUE),
    exp_A    = sum(exp_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    exp_notA = sum(exp_notA, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

totals %>%
  mutate(
    obs_prop_A = obs_A / (obs_A + obs_notA),
    exp_prop_A = exp_A / (exp_A + exp_notA)
  )


chisq.test(
  x = c(totals$obs_A, totals$obs_notA),
  p = c(totals$exp_A, totals$exp_notA) / (totals$exp_A + totals$exp_notA),
  rescale.p = TRUE,
  correct=TRUE ##yates correction
)




###  plot

df_prop <- df %>%
  mutate(Observed = obs_A / (obs_A + obs_notA),
         Expected = exp_A / (exp_A + exp_notA)) %>%
  select(device_id, Observed, Expected) %>%
  pivot_longer(-device_id, names_to = "type", values_to = "proportion")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

dodge_width <- 0.9


zero_obs <- df_prop %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == "Observed", proportion == 0)

bar_width <- 0.4

f=ggplot(df_prop, aes(x = as.factor(device_id), y = proportion, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  # # horizontal lines for zero Observed bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = zero_obs,
    aes(
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = 0.0001
    ),
    width = 0.5,  # controls horizontal length of the line (0-1 in discrete units)
    color = "steelblue",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.25)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed" = "steelblue", "Expected" = "orange")) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of time in the Rotor Swept Area", x = "Individual ID") + #, title = "A."
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "serif"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, family = "serif"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, family = "serif"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.1, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "serif")
  )


# Calculate overall totals
totals <- df %>%
  summarise(
    obs_A = sum(obs_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_notA = sum(obs_notA, na.rm = TRUE),
    exp_A = sum(exp_A, na.rm = TRUE),
    exp_notA = sum(exp_notA, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Compute proportions for Buffer A
overall_prop <- totals %>%
  summarise(
    Observed = obs_A / (obs_A + obs_notA),
    Expected = exp_A / (exp_A + exp_notA)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "type", values_to = "proportion")

# Plot
g=ggplot(overall_prop, aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed" = "steelblue", "Expected" = "orange")) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of time in the Rotor Swept Area", x = "", fill = "") + #, title="B."
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(proportion, 3)), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), vjust = -0.2, size = 5, family = "serif")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +  # increases all base text sizes
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "serif"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    # legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none", 
    # legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "serif")
  )

library(patchwork)



h <- f + g +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

h

ggsave(
  here("data", "updated PlosOne figures",
       "hr-observed vs expected time in RSA.tiff"),
  h,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

Bootstrapping: time in RHR

```{r}
set.seed(123)

n_sims <- 1000

preds <- d5 %>%
  select(
    device_id,
    id,
    position,
    buffer_type,
    date,
    time_diff,
    z_fit1,
    z_fit1.se
  ) %>%
  tidyr::uncount(n_sims, .id = "simulation") %>%
  mutate(
    z_sim = rnorm(
      n(),
      mean = z_fit1,
      sd = z_fit1.se
    ),
    id_sim = paste0(id, "_", simulation)
  )







point_summary <- preds %>%
  group_by(
    device_id,
    id,
    position,
    buffer_type,
    date,
    time_diff
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    z_fit1_mean = mean(z_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_fit1_lower = quantile(z_sim, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_fit1_upper = quantile(z_sim, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


rm(point_summary)
gc()



```


Time in RSA plot


```{r}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

p_boot=read.csv(here("data", 
                    "Nosazeogie_GBBG_in_RHR_WEA_bootstrapped_summary_for_dryad.csv")) 
# point summary/L3d_highres_bootstrapped_summary


p_boot <- p_boot %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_diff))

# Step 1: Filter to in_WEA only
in_WEA_RHR1 <- p_boot %>%
  filter(position == "in Wind Energy Area") %>%
  dplyr::select(device_id, buffer_type, time_diff, z_fit1_mean, z_fit1_lower, z_fit1_upper)

# Step 2: For each id and buffer_type, calculate:
#   - total time in buffer
#   - time in buffer with altitude between 27–255 m
in_WEA_RHR1_summary <- in_WEA_RHR1 %>%
  group_by(device_id, buffer_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_minutes = sum(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    time_in_RHR_mean = sum(time_diff[z_fit1_mean >= 27 & z_fit1_mean <= 255], na.rm = TRUE),
    time_in_RHR_lci = sum(time_diff[z_fit1_lower >= 27 & z_fit1_lower <= 255], na.rm = TRUE),
    time_in_RHR_uci = sum(time_diff[z_fit1_upper >= 27 & z_fit1_upper <= 255], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


library(sf)
# Step 3: Pivot wider so both buffer types are side-by-side
in_WEA_RHR1_wide <- in_WEA_RHR1_summary %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = device_id,
    names_from = buffer_type,
    values_from = c(
      total_minutes,
      time_in_RHR_mean,
      time_in_RHR_lci,
      time_in_RHR_uci
    ),
    values_fill = 0
  )





# Step 4: Calculate per-id percentages (main table 1)

### using only buffer_2200m since buffers are nested; is this correct? NO

# both buffers used since my interest is in WEA in general

in_WEA_RHR1_pct <- in_WEA_RHR1_wide %>%
  mutate(
    # Total time across the two buffers
    total_time = total_minutes_buffer_2200m, # + total_minutes_buffer_116m

    # Mean estimate
    time_in_RHR_mean = time_in_RHR_mean_buffer_2200m, # + total_minutes_buffer_116m

    # Lower CI estimate
    time_in_RHR_lci = time_in_RHR_lci_buffer_2200m, # + total_minutes_buffer_116m

    # Upper CI estimate
    time_in_RHR_uci = time_in_RHR_uci_buffer_2200m, # + total_minutes_buffer_116m

    # Percent of time in RHR
    pct_in_RHR_mean = (time_in_RHR_mean / total_time) * 100,
    pct_in_RHR_lci  = (time_in_RHR_lci / total_time) * 100,
    pct_in_RHR_uci  = (time_in_RHR_uci / total_time) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(
    device_id,
    total_time,
    time_in_RHR_mean,
    time_in_RHR_lci,
    time_in_RHR_uci,
    pct_in_RHR_mean,
    pct_in_RHR_lci,
    pct_in_RHR_uci
  )




# Step 5: Overall percentage across all ids (last row in main table 1)
overall_RHR1_pct <- in_WEA_RHR1_pct %>%
  summarise(
    device_id = "overall",
    
    total_time = sum(total_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    time_in_RHR_mean = sum(time_in_RHR_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    time_in_RHR_lci  = sum(time_in_RHR_lci, na.rm = TRUE),
    time_in_RHR_uci  = sum(time_in_RHR_uci, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    pct_in_RHR_mean = (time_in_RHR_mean / total_time) * 100,
    pct_in_RHR_lci  = (time_in_RHR_lci / total_time) * 100,
    pct_in_RHR_uci  = (time_in_RHR_uci / total_time) * 100
  )


write.table(overall_RHR1_pct,
            "clipboard",
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE)


### plot


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

# Create height categories for mean, lower CI, and upper CI
time_by_height <- in_WEA_RHR1 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(buffer_type=="buffer_2200m") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_height_category = case_when(
      z_fit1_mean < 27 ~ "Below RHR",
      z_fit1_mean >= 27 & z_fit1_mean <= 255 ~ "In RHR",
      z_fit1_mean > 255 ~ "Above RHR",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    
    lci_height_category = case_when(
      z_fit1_lower < 27 ~ "Below RHR",
      z_fit1_lower >= 27 & z_fit1_lower <= 255 ~ "In RHR",
      z_fit1_lower > 255 ~ "Above RHR",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    
    uci_height_category = case_when(
      z_fit1_upper < 27 ~ "Below RHR",
      z_fit1_upper >= 27 & z_fit1_upper <= 255 ~ "In RHR",
      z_fit1_upper > 255 ~ "Above RHR",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Put the three estimates into long format
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      mean_height_category,
      lci_height_category,
      uci_height_category
    ),
    names_to = "estimate",
    values_to = "height_category"
  ) %>%
  
  # Sum time within each device, height category, and estimate
  group_by(device_id, height_category, estimate) %>%
  summarise(
    total_minutes = sum(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Put mean, LCI, and UCI into separate columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = estimate,
    values_from = total_minutes,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  
  rename(
    time_mean = mean_height_category,
    time_lci = lci_height_category,
    time_uci = uci_height_category)

    
    
 ## note that for some device_ids, the above table does not make sense: lower < mean < upper ci is not always true
# but below, it plots correctly, how?
    
    
    
    
    
    
q1 <- ggplot(
  time_by_height,
  aes(
    x = factor(device_id),
    y = time_mean,
    fill = height_category
  )
) +
  
  # Side-by-side bars
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # CI error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = time_lci,
      ymax = time_uci
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Individual ID",
    y = "Time (in minutes)",
    fill = "Height Category"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Below RHR" = "skyblue",
      "In RHR" = "orange",
      "Above RHR" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1, family = "serif"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", family = "serif"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "serif"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 5,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0, family = "serif"
    )
  )

q1
```
